hypothesis: Core Pulselive standings endpoint is fully public and can be called directly via HTTPS GET without auth or special headers.
rationale: Network exploration shows repeated unauthenticated GETs to https://sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com/api/v5/competitions/8/seasons/2025/standings with no Authorization or cookies. We need to confirm this holds in a fresh browser context and whether any required headers (e.g. Origin, Referer, User-Agent) matter.
prompt:
1. Use browser_navigate to open https://www.premierleague.com/en/ just to establish a realistic origin context.
2. Then, using browser_eval_js, run a fetch to "https://sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com/api/v5/competitions/8/seasons/2025/standings" with method GET and no custom headers (let the browser send defaults). Capture and return:
   - HTTP status
   - Any CORS errors or exceptions
   - A truncated (first 2KB) JSON body if the response is OK.
3. If the fetch fails due to CORS, retry by:
   a) Navigating directly to the API URL with browser_navigate and capturing the raw response body text.
   b) If that still fails, use capture_search_transactions with a query for "standings" to pull the exact recorded request, then use browser_cdp_command (Network.enable + Page.navigate or Fetch.enable) to replicate the working request as closely as possible and capture the JSON response.
Return a concise report of what worked, including final method used and any required headers or preconditions.
summary: Standings endpoint is publicly accessible via simple GET from premierleague.com origin with no custom headers or auth; fetch returns 200 OK and JSON standings data without CORS issues.

output.summary: Experiment on Premier League standings API from realistic origin context.

steps.description: Establish origin context by navigating to Premier League site.
Call fetch to standings API from page context with default headers.
Fallback if CORS failure: navigate directly to API URL and/or replay from capture via CDP.
steps.reasonNotExecuted: Not needed; initial fetch succeeded with 200 OK and no CORS errors.

finalOutcome.corsStatus: No CORS errors; cross-origin request permitted from this origin to sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com for this endpoint.
finalOutcome.requiredHeaders: None beyond browser defaults; no custom Authorization or other headers were supplied.
finalOutcome.notes: The API returned valid JSON standings data for competition 8, season 2025. Only the first ~2KB of the body were captured as requested.
